content_of_post_to_answer: How do you deal with overthinking when someone makes a nasty comment about you?
answer: A nasty comment often hurts less because of the words themselves and more because our mind starts treating them as evidence about who we are. A useful question is: “Is this information, or just someone’s reaction?” Not every opinion deserves equal authority. The trap in overthinking is trying to solve the wrong problem—proving your worth to someone who may have never been judging you fairly. You can learn from criticism without handing over control of your self-image.
